subject: Close runway deviation — action snapshot and MAP commitments
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close runway deviation — action snapshot and MAP commitments

Elena,

Quick note following our internal check this morning — flagging the MAP so we have a short, shared action snapshot and owners. We see procurement questionnaire + legal review as the primary drag on the agreed close date. At a high level: 

- Current committed close: 2026-06-30 (MAP v1)
- Risk: procurement security questionnaire pending; legal redlines expected (2–3 weeks if any back-and-forth)
- Impact: likely slip window = 3–5 weeks if procurement remains in review

Attachment: MAP_Veridian_v2.xlsx (updated timeline + owner cells)

Suggested immediate mitigations (to avoid blocking go-live):
1) Temporary dedicated capacity and canary acceptance for a scoped pilot (limit of 50k tokens/day) — allows product team to validate integration without full contract finalization.
2) Enter an acceptance-conditional clause in the MAP (minimal legal language) to allow parallel workstreams.
3) Weekly MAP sync (15 min) between procurement/legal + our CS/solutions lead — run cadence until acceptance.

Asks for you: can procurement share an ETA on the security questionnaire completion by EOD Thursday? If procurement needs a formal intake, loop in the procurement alias and I'll provide the digest and our SOC artefacts.

I’ll coordinate a short MAP update doc and drop it into the HubSpot deal record once we align.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

--
Attachment: MAP_Veridian_v2.xlsx (1 sheet — timeline, owners, fallback options)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@veridianhealth.com>

Marcus — thanks for the clear snapshot.

Reality on our side: procurement intake is live but the security questionnaire flagged a request for additional evidence around logging/audit retention and VPC controls. That adds an extra review loop with our security team. At the moment I can commit to a tentative procurement completion target of 2026-07-22, pending there are no major redlines. I have looped procurement on this thread.

We have attached an internal summary to help (procurement_digest.pdf) and will surface specific fields in the questionnaire that we need Redwood to respond to. If you can provide the SOC/HSM details and a short paragraph on data residency by EOD Thursday, that will speed our internal review.

Elena Park
Director, Digital Platforms | Veridian Health
elena.park@veridianhealth.com

Looping in a quick mitigation proposal from CS/solutions:

We can scope a 2-week canary acceptance that covers the highest-risk API paths (auth, tokenization, embeddings). Core points:
- Deploy into a customer-dedicated pool with token cap and monitoring (we can turn on extended logging for the pilot only).
- Provide a one-page SOC summary + HSM/KMS integration notes by Thursday to satisfy the immediate evidence ask.
- Offer a limited-time credit for the canary (one month of dedicated capacity at no charge) to remove procurement cost objections while they finalize paperwork.

If Veridian agrees, we should update the MAP with a parallel track: Pilot acceptance (by 2026-07-01) and Final close (after procurement complete, target 2026-07-22). That reduces product risk and keeps momentum.

Happy to run the pilot plan with solutions on a call — Marcus, can you confirm whether we have capacity to stand up the dedicated pool next week?

— Marissa

Thanks all — summary and commitments below (please treat this as the MAP update for the HubSpot deal record):

1) New MAP tracks (parallel):
   - Pilot acceptance (target): 2026-07-01 — scoped canary on dedicated pool (owner: Marissa Cole)
   - Contract close (target): 2026-07-22 — procurement/legal completion (owner: Elena Park / Procurement Team)

2) Immediate deliverables (owner / due):
   - SOC/HSM & data residency one-pager (Redwood) / due: 2026-06-18 EOD — owner: Karthik Iyer
   - Questionnaire responses (Veridian) / due: 2026-06-24 — owner: Procurement Team
   - Canopy pilot capacity: provisioning window confirmed for next week (Marissa to coordinate) — owner: Marissa Cole

3) Escalation path:
   - If procurement misses the 2026-06-24 checklist items, Sales leadership (Neha) to engage procurement execs for prioritized review.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7832 (I will update the timeline and attach MAP_Veridian_v2.xlsx); https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPNotes

Action required: Elena / Procurement — confirm the 2026-07-22 target by Friday COB and call out any blockers we should raise to Neha now.

I will flag this as an escalation in the weekly close-watch meeting if we don't have confirmation by Friday.

Thanks —
